text:
Ravi N: Quick sync  I'm updating the Dedicated provisioning examples to include an 'isolation + autoscale' example that callers can copy. support keeps getting tripped when customers combine tenant_isolation with aggressive cooldowns.

Claire P: Yup. We should demonstrate a safe default: cooldown >= 5m when tenant_isolation labels are used, and show why in a short rationale line.

Noah J: From runtime: isolated placement increases scheduling churn; short cooldowns cause oscillation because placement takes time. Recommend sample YAML + CLI + one-liner SDK.

Ravi N: Draft YAML sample:
```yaml
pool:
  id: example-pool
  placement:
    tenant_isolation:
      labels: ["regulatory-tier-a"]
  scalePolicy:
    cooldown: 300s    # recommended minimum when using isolation
    target:
      min: 2
      max: 20
    graceful_scale: true
```

Claire P: Add a short explanation under the snippet: "Why 300s? isolation placement can add scheduling latency; longer cooldown avoids flip-flopping and accidental SLA breaches." Keep it one sentence.

Noah J: Add a CLI patch example customers can copy: `rwctl pool patch --id $POOL --set placement.tenant_isolation.labels=[regulatory-tier-a] --set scalePolicy.cooldown=300s`

Ravi N: JS SDK patch snippet (1-line):
```js
await client.patchPool(poolId, { scalePolicy: { cooldown: 300, graceful_scale: true } })
```

Claire P: Also include a short matrix row in the handbook "When to increase cooldown" referencing isolation, large KV caches, and cross-region failovers. Support loves quick lookup rows.

Noah J: Suggest wording for SLA note: "Note: time spent during placement/drain counts toward capacity commitments; increasing cooldown reduces churn but does not alter capacity accounting."

Ravi N: I'll open a tiny PR with these changes and the matrix row. docs-bot: please run link-checker against /docs/dedicated/provisioning and the SLA page in the same PR.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5350 branch: docs/provisioning/isolation-autoscale-examples

Claire P: pinging eng-runtime for a quick confirm on the phrasing; also requesting a short unit test to validate graceful_scale behavior so examples remain accurate.

Noah J: I'll add a runtime note in the PR review: graceful_scale delays eviction of warm replicas but does not pause cooldown timers. copying runtime-approved language here so docs match: "graceful_scale reduces eviction of warm instances to preserve cache; autoscale cooldowns continue to elapse."

Ravi N: action items: (1) me: PR with YAML/CLI/JS + matrix row, (2) Claire: review wording and add SLA cross-ref, (3) Noah: runtime confirm + test link. aim to merge today.

docs-bot: CI: lint ok. link-checker flagged a relative link to docs/dedicated/sla.md. Suggested target: /docs/dedicated/sla/commitments.md

Ravi N: fixed links and updated SLA cross-ref in branch. pushing change. :shipit:

docs-bot: PR merged (5350) by Ravi N  changes deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/docs/dedicated/isolation-autoscale.html

Claire P: Verified staging. matrix row helps. leaving one tiny grammar nit in the intro.

Noah J: Verified runtime behaviour with a local sim; sample matches reality. good to promote.

Ravi N: thanks all, closing thread.
